_comment: Book for the two Gazimon (BT25-078) lines that the shared three_musketeers_pool.json cannot host. `three-musketeers-gazimon` is the shared `three-musketeers` list with two edits: (1) the egg deck is BT25-005 Pagumon (BLACK, [TS] trait) instead of ST6-01 -- a Black Lv.2 does NOT satisfy Gazimon's printed Purple Lv.2 circle, so the only legal breeding-digivolve is the '[Digivolve] Lv.2 w/[Three Musketeers] in text or w/[TS] trait: Cost 0' condition under exam (BT25-078#effect#0); BT25-005 also carries no [On Deletion], unlike ST6-01, whose 'trash the top 2 cards' would stack a second trigger beside <Retaliation> in the inherited#0 line. (2) Two EX7-070 are swapped for two ST6-07 Youkomon -- a VANILLA Purple Lv.4 (6000 DP, Purple Lv.3 / 2) so Gazimon can be a digivolution card under a top card that prints no effect at all, isolating its inherited <Retaliation>. `quiet-opponent` is copied verbatim from the shared book so one --decks argument resolves both seats.
